tv: Karbonn / Motorola / Thomson SWTV-20AE and Hyundai TV (Skyworth OEM, SW4H, MediaTek), India and Latin America
notes: Same SW4H platform as Panasonic 4KTV-0SU, also sold as Motorola SWTV-20AE and as the Thomson 43OATHPRO2000 by Super Plastronics (same build); Skyworth ACR, ad-row injector, ePop demo, e-manual, Airtel Xstream, Facebook and India-specific preloads; Google feedback and recommendation rows; 1.68 GB RAM, 32-bit armeabi-v7a; com.sky.market is a protected package (SecurityException); animation scales halved + background_process_limit 2 for extra performance on low RAM; Live TV is com.smartdevice.livetv; tvrecommendations caused 2 s system freezes (D-pad runaway) on the Motorola unit; firmware resets the screensaver at boot. Unit 4 is a Hyundai-branded set sold in Latin America (device SW4H, product SW4H_B, the same build, 1.72 GB RAM) with its own list, `debloat-hyundai-sw4h.txt`, which adds Home Workouts and the Beach Buggy demo to the same set
